images.title: Noushella
images.description:
NOUSHELLA is a London-based luxury womenswear project developed around seven female archetypes: mother, maiden, huntress, mystic, queen, sage and lover. Every garment in the collection was designed by Jalal Mashhadi Fard, translating psychological identity into silhouette, geometry, texture and movement. The collection treats clothing as an expressive architecture for the body—an outer form capable of holding memory, character and inner light.

Fashion Designer and Creative Director: Jalal Mashhadi Fard · Founder and Design Psychology Advisor: Noush Navazani
